notes.glasses: Eyeglasses are strictly forbidden unless a signed medical waiver from a doctor is provided.
notes.smile: Neutral facial expression or natural smile, with both eyes open and mouth closed.
notes.ears: Ears need not be visible, but hairline and facial edges must not be obscured by hair or headwear.
notes.shadows: Shadows on the face or behind the head on the background are not acceptable.
notes.babyRules: No other person or hands in photo. Baby may lie on a plain white sheet or sit in a car seat covered with a white sheet.
